scope: Time effects (echo, time split, shutter, stutter) on synthetic fixtures: a 640x360 frame-barcode video, a 320x180 flat-grey lossless video, a white bar and a coloured still image, a generated click track; server stills and exports, one browser export, the paused editor preview. Correctness, agreement, decoder budget and flash safety at defaults; one cost sample. Not covered: real footage, playback frame rate in the editor, a hardware graphics adapter, the owner's laptop.

analysedBeats.method: spectral-flux onsets + dynamic-programming beat tracking (no model); assumes a steady pulse; no regular bar accent found

cost.note: server export, software canvas, one run on this machine; not a target

checks.name: time.split (stills): red shows frame F, green F − 4, blue F − 8 (never before the clip start), read as one barcode per channel on 120 stills in a shuffled order: 0 errors
Seek equals sequential: the same 120 stills rendered in a shuffled order are byte-identical to those rendered in order
time.split (export): every frame of a 90-frame export carries the three barcodes, 0 errors
time.split across a cut at frame 37: stills of frames 37–45 are byte-identical to those of the uncut clip
Grey fixture: every frame decodes to one flat grey (the reference levels g(F) for the echo checks)
time.echo blend (stills, defaults): each still equals (ΣW_k·g(F − 3k) + 2048) >> 12 exactly, with W from tapWeights (sum 4096) and clamped at the clip start
time.echo blend (export): every frame of the export is within ±3 of the formula on the encoded levels
time.echo lighten (stills): each still equals max_k ((G_k·g(F − 3k) + 2048) >> 12), G_k = round(4096·0.6^k)
time.shutter at 360°: a bar moving 16 px a frame is smeared into the box-filter model (eight places one frame wide), within 3 of 255 on every pixel of the row
time.shutter at 0°: byte-identical to the clip without the effect (moving bar)
time.shutter at 0°: byte-identical to no effect on a video clip (frames 10 and 77)
Titles (no decode), time.echo: the still is the weighted sum of the title at frames 20, 17, 14 and 11 (within 2 of 255 on every pixel: straight-alpha rounding at the letter edges)
Titles (no decode), time.stutter: frame 20 shows the title exactly as on frame 18 (held with its movement)
time.stutter (export, hold 3): every frame shows the picture of F − F mod 3
time.stutter with a cut at frame 37: the same frames as without the cut

time.stutter following the music (export): the picture changes only on planned beat frames (thinned, at least flashGapFrames apart) and shows the frame of the latest one; steady steps before the first beat

checks.name: Decode lanes: in the same project the still of frame 22 (all three play; 11 decoders, as pictures shown twice are decoded once) is delivered
Decode lanes: preflight lists decode_budget for exactly the frames that need more than 12 decoders (24–39, up to 15), naming the three clips

detail.message: on frames 24–39, more video pictures must be decoded at once than the 12 the renderer can open (up to 15); those frames would be refused. Time effects such as echo and time split decode each earlier picture separately (a picture shown more than once in a frame is decoded once). Lower the count of a time effect, remove one, or move the overlapping clips apart
